newsitem.title: ALGERIA: Arab monitors say Algeria poll free and fair.
newsitem.headline: Arab monitors say Algeria poll free and fair.

text.p: Arab League monitors said Algeria's parliamentary elections on Thursday were proceeding in a fair and free atmosphere.
"The general evaluation until now is that the performance (in the elections) is excellent," Kamal Said, chief of 61 Arab League officials monitoring the poll, told Reuters.
"Our observers spread across the country have not received any complaints...I have not seen any pressure on voters and there are no doubts about the integrity of the elections," he said.

The Arab observers are among some 200 monitors from the United States, Europe, Africa and the Middle East supervising the first general election since Algeria plunged into violence and bloodshed five years ago.
